request.deadline: 18 months from programme start, with gates at Month 6, Month 12, and Month 18
deliverables: 18-month programme across India, Cambodia, and Kenya

M1 Stand-Up at Month 6 with Foundation operational, 200,000 cumulative farmers registered on Mainnet, AE credentialing live, trust-layer architecture locked, auditor procurement concluded, and legal contract transfer prepared
M2 Closed Loop at Month 12 with 350,000 farmers, three application paths operating against verified trust-layer records, first stablecoin-rail loans disbursed and tracked, and first independent audit

M3 Self-Sustaining at Month 18 with 500,000 cumulative verified farmers, three application paths operating, finance activity on Cardano, AE network credentialed, active Foundation revenue model, and final independent audit
Public on-chain KPI dashboard, quarterly narrative reports, and monthly Cardano Forum updates
request.recipient: 5am.earth Foundation, with pre-Foundation co-promoters Elk GMBH and HashPoint Consulting until registration and Intersect administering treasury contracts on standard terms.
request.what: 5am.earth Foundation requests treasury funding to build an open, Cardano-anchored trust layer for global agricultural supply chains combining Veridian self-sovereign identity, a Cardano on-chain satellite oracle, and three application paths across AE certification, traceability/compliance, and finance/credit.

claims.claim: Project Swaminathan is operating on Cardano Mainnet with 10,500 cumulative farmer and farm registrations as of 5 May 2026.
The proposal says the funded programme will reach 500,000 registered farmers across India, Cambodia, and Kenya by Month 18.

The trust layer will combine farmer and AE identity, verified land and crop data, satellite observations, credentials, application events, and Cardano anchoring into reusable infrastructure for agricultural applications.
The Cardano components are described as already implemented and operational on Project Swaminathan, making the work integration and scaling rather than greenfield development.
The three funded-period application paths are Andamio AE certification, Zengate Global traceability and compliance, and Seedstars SIGMA finance and credit.
The 10,000,000 ADA request is structured as 5,000,000 ADA on approval, 2,000,000 ADA on M1 acceptance, and 3,000,000 ADA on M2 acceptance.
The proposal states the ask is approximately 2.86% of the ratified 350,000,000 ADA Net Change Limit.
If ADA price appreciation creates surplus above $3.5 million, the surplus returns to the Treasury, while no top-up is requested if ADA price falls.
By 2030, the programme projects 3 million farmers, 112.5 million annual on-chain transactions, $900 million TVL, and 16–20 million ADA in annual protocol revenue.

Intersect would administer funds through the Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and Project-Specific Smart Contract framework, with an Oversight Committee of five named external entities verifying key administrative actions.

summary: The document requests 10,000,000 ADA for an 18-month, milestone-gated agricultural trust-layer scale-up administered by Intersect, with claimed existing Mainnet operations, named partners, three application paths, and ambitious adoption and 2030 economic projections.
